alternatives.argument: This is a parameter definition, so no deductive proof is claimed. The positive inputs k_B>0 and T>0 make beta_phys=1/(k_B T) a well-defined positive inverse-energy parameter; beta_hat=E_* beta_phys is dimensionless because E_* is an energy. Tong Statistical Physics §1.3.1 independently gives the canonical beta convention. The definition keeps k_B and T as explicit finite-regulator inputs.

This is an adopted physical state convention, not a deductive theorem. Its well-defined normalized operator is conditional on the local QFT-IR01 Gibbs-trace theorem: with beta_hat>0, that theorem proves positive trace-class exp(-beta_hat h), finite positive Z, and a normalized density operator. Tong Statistical Physics §1.3.1 supplies independent canonical-ensemble context.

Let beta_hat=E_* beta_phys. The physical Hamiltonian is E_*h, so its Gibbs weights exp(-beta_phys E_* lambda_k) equal the dimensionless QFT-IR01 weights exp(-beta_hat lambda_k). Apply the local Gibbs-trace theorem at beta_hat to get the finite partition-function bound and absolute trace formula. For an effect E_a supplied by the current QFT-C01 measurement postulate, substitute B=E_a in that trace formula. Tong Statistical Physics §1.3.1 supplies independent physical ensemble interpretation; the finite trace and normalization proof is local and conditional.
